author: Bamidele Akinwumi research workflow (Codex-assisted)

h1.endpoint: source detail MSE over the full 512x512 evaluation region
h1.relative_reduction_formula: -(mean paired difference) / mean dpir_nominal detail MSE

bootstrap.interval: two-sided 95% percentile interval using numpy linear quantiles
bootstrap.shared_multiplicities: One outcome-blind multiplicity matrix is reused across primary, secondary and calibration endpoints.

sign_flip.generator: numpy.random.default_rng(seed), reset separately for H1 and H2

confirmatory_gate: Each hypothesis must independently pass its 5% practical threshold, Holm-adjusted one-sided p<0.05, and paired-bootstrap upper confidence limit<0.

calibration.scope: All seven frozen acquisition chains pooled; each of the 40 sources has equal total weight.
calibration.target: centre 16x16 patch detail RMSE > 0.05 for fbcnn_dpir_nominal
calibration.equal_mass_bin_rule: Stable sort by mapped probability; assign bins from weighted cumulative midpoints on the full independent cohort.
calibration.bootstrap_bin_rule: Keep full-cohort bin assignments fixed and source-bootstrap the within-bin weighted probability and event totals.
metrics: calibration-in-the-large as source-equal mean(target - mapped probability)
calibration slope from source-weighted logistic regression of target on logit(mapped probability), clipping probabilities to [1e-6,1-1e-6]
calibration.intervals: 10,000-replicate source-bootstrap 95% percentile intervals for all pooled metrics.
calibration.per_chain_outputs: Point estimates for Brier, ECE and calibration-in-the-large are exploratory diagnostics.

secondary_outputs.quality: Source-mean estimates and 95% source-bootstrap intervals by chain and reconstruction method.
secondary_outputs.risk_coverage: Source-mean estimates and 95% source-bootstrap intervals by chain, pipeline, region, score and coverage.
secondary_outputs.interpretation: Secondary outcomes cannot rescue a failed confirmatory gate.

one_time_rule: The analysis refuses an existing final output directory. It verifies all five sealed shards before creating a temporary unsealing workspace and publishes the final directory atomically.
claim_boundary: The Stage-05E output decides the predeclared independent experimental gates. It does not by itself establish the final literature novelty claim, which requires the locked Stage-05F synthesis.
